jobs.title: HR Generalist / HR Administration (Part-Time, 20–25h/week)
jobs.description:
Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

Your Role

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

Key Responsibilities

HR Strategy & Policies


  • Develop and improve HR policies across the group
  • Ensure compliance with Dutch and EU labor law
  • Support HR projects and organizational development initiatives


Operational HR Management


  • Advise management on HR-related topics
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment and hiring processes
  • Coordinate onboarding and employee development programs
  • Maintain job descriptions, compensation structures and performance processes
  • Collaborate with international teams (e.g. Portugal)


HR Administration


  • Maintain employee records, contracts and HR systems
  • Support payroll preparation with external providers
  • Manage absences (vacation, sick leave, etc.)
  • Prepare HR reports (headcount, turnover, KPIs)
  • Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries


Your Profile


  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or similar
  • Minimum 2 years of HR experience (HR Generalist or similar role)
  • Knowledge of labor law (NL/EU preferred)
  • Experience with MS Office and HR systems
  • Fluent in English and Dutch


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary package and attractive corporate benefits
  • Full-time equivalent salary: €4,000–€4,500 per month
  • Permanent role in a stable, internationally operating company
  • Professional training and development opportunities
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Long-term perspective within a family-owned industrial group


Apply now and become part of the LOEWE Group!

jobs.title: Development Team Lead- Team Notification & Communication
jobs.description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. jobs.title: We need 2 rescue zookeeper in rescue zoo
jobs.description:
Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

  • One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

  • One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

  • A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

  • Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

  • Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

  • A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

  • Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

  • Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

  • Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

jobs.title: 16 år gammel gutt søker assistenter til en ny BPA ordning i Fyllingsdalen
jobs.description:
Hei!Jeg er en 16 år gammel gutt som bor i Fyllingsdalen. Hjemme liker jeg blant annet å legge puslespill, høre på musikk og se på YouTube. Jeg trives godt med rolige dager, men når været er fint, går jeg gjerne en lenger tur i nærområdet. Jeg bruker også tredemøllen hjemme for å holde meg i aktivitet.

Nå skal jeg få min egen BPA-ordning, og derfor ser jeg etter trygge og hyggelige assistenter som vil bli kjent med meg og være med på å skape gode dager. Siden ordningen er helt ny, får du også mulighet til å være med fra starten og bidra til gode rutiner rundt meg.

Jeg er nonverbal og viser hva jeg ønsker og trenger gjennom signaler og kroppsspråk. Det er derfor viktig at du tar deg tid til å bli kjent med meg og lærer å forstå uttrykkene mine. Jeg har også epilepsi. Dersom jeg får et anfall, trenger jeg en assistent som klarer å beholde roen og følge rutinene mine. Du får god opplæring, så det er ikke nødvendig å ha erfaring med dette fra før.

Som assistent blir din viktigste oppgave å være til stede, gi meg støtte når jeg trenger det og bidra til at jeg får fine og trygge dager. Noen ganger passer det godt med en aktivitet eller en tur, mens andre ganger trenger jeg ro hjemme.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg søker deg som:

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Er observant og god til å lese signaler
  • Trives med rolige arbeidsdager
  • Tar initiativ til enkle aktiviteter
  • Er komfortabel med å bistå med personlig stell
Arbeidstid og stilling

Vi søker tilkallingsvikarer og deltidsansatte.Arbeidstidene vil hovedsakelig være:

Ukedager

  • Fra ca. kl. 15.00 til 19.00. Det er behov for assistenter tre ukedager, men hvilke dager dette gjelder er fleksibelt og kan avtales nærmere i forbindelse med intervju.

Helger

  • Lørdag og søndag ca. kl. 12:00-19:00

Skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mange dager i uken du ønsker å jobbe, og hvilke dager som passer best for deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver kan være:
  • Tilsyn og støtte i hverdagen
  • Bli med på turer og andre aktiviteter
  • Motivere til aktivitet og sosialt samvær
  • Bistå med personlig stell

Dersom du kjører bil til jobb, er det gode parkeringsmuligheter rett utenfor boligen.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

  • participating in grant application activities
  • coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirementsAppointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-trackWhen appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

  • Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
  • A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
  • A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
  • Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.      Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

  • Ability to remain organized and deliver excellent service during busy periods.
  • Strong teamwork skills and a willingness to learn.

  • A newly renovated restaurant with ambitious plans for the future.
  • A professional and welcoming working environment.
  • The chance to work with authentic Italian cuisine and quality wines.

Interested?

Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme, isäämme, ystäväämme tai lastamme.Mikä on helpperi?Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle avustettavalle henkilölle, kuten lapselle. Helpperi tukee asiakasta kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, päivittäisissä toimissa, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain seurana ollessa ja huolehtien. Ajan myötä helpperistä, asiakkaasta ja hänen perheestään voi tulla läheisiä keskenään.Etsimme tiimiimme sote-alan koulutettuja hoitajia auttamaan lapsiperheitäAsiakkaisiimme kuuluu niin lapsia kuin lapsiperheitä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan lapsiperheitä heidän hektisessä ja kiireisessä elämäntilanteessa tarjoamalla arvokasta aikaasi lapsiperheen arjen pyörittämiseen. Tehtävät voivat liittyä lapsien kanssa leikkimiseen ja ulkoiluun aina kodinhoidollisiin askareisiin, kuten roskien viemiseen. Välillä käynnit voivat sujua ihan vain yhdessä puuhaillen vaikkapa värityskirjan äärellä.Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Helppereitämme yhdistää halu viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa. Tässä työssä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki olisi parempaa ja helpompaa. Annamme lisäpisteitä, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä!Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat: "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen asiakkaan kanssa." "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."Helpperinä saat:- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan. - Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA📅 Tiltredelse: 1/2-27📌 Stillingstype: Fast⏰ Arbeidstid: Hovedsakelig dagtid, men noen kvelder og helger kan bli aktuelt

Hei!

Jeg er en voksen og positiv dame i 60-årene som bor i Arendal. Nå ser jeg etter en fast assistent som kan bli en viktig del av hverdagen min. Jeg liker å være ute med rullestol når været er fint og på besøk til venner og familie, og det hadde vært ekstra hyggelig om du kunne være med på opplevelsene. Jeg liker å lage mat hjemme, og hos familien når jeg er hos dem. Da lager jeg mat fra bunnen og prøver gjerne nye retter fra ulike kulturer. Kanskje vi kan lage noe spennende sammen? Jeg har også barnebarn, som jeg ønsker at du kan være med og tilrettelegge slik at vi kan være med dem og leke og ha det moro sammen!

Jeg lever med en muskelsykdom som gradvis gjør at jeg trenger mer praktisk hjelp i hverdagen. Det betyr at du som assistent vil være mine armer og bein i mange situasjoner. Målet mitt er å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv på mine egne premisser – og til det trenger jeg deg! Familie, barnebarn og venner betyr mye for meg, og det gjør også firbeinte familiemedlemmer, så det er viktig at du liker både barn og dyr.

Arbeidstid og stilling:

  • En fast assistent som kan jobbe ca. 11 timer i uken, med mulighet for å også være vikar ved sykdom/ferie.

Det vil hovedsakelig være dagtid to dager i uken, fra hhv. kl. 9 til 15 og 09 til 14. Ønsker gjerne at du kan være fleksibel, slik at vaktene kan endres ved behov. Det kan også tidvis bli aktuelt med arbeid på kveld og i helg.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Assistere under trening hjemme og ute

  • Være med på besøk til venner og familie

  • Personlig stell/hygiene

  • Hjelpe til med matlaging

  • Snømåking

  • Hagearbeid

  • Husarbeid

  • Bistå ved forflytning hjemme og utenfor hjemmet

  • Håndtere og løfte rullestol og andre hjelpemidler

  • Hjelpe meg med å kjøre dit jeg skal

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • Følge system og rutiner

  • Engasjert og selvstendig

  • Ærlig og pålitelig

  • God humor og glimt i øyet

  • Trives med barn og dyr

  • Fysisk sterk for å kunne løfte utstyr og hjelpe meg dersom jeg skulle falle

  • Være proaktiv, kreativ og se løsninger

  • Trygg på bilkjøring

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Kan fremlegge gyldig politiattest

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Egen bil er en fordel

Send inn søknad snarest – aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende.

Gleder meg til å høre fra deg! 🙋‍♀️

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.

jobs.title: Portugal Content Specialist
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We're looking for an ambitious, growth-obsessed Content Specialist who basically thinks in TikToks. Someone who gets fired up by great content, knows what's trending before it trends, and wants to take Bump to #1 on the App Store in Portugal (and keep it there).

You'll be the person bringing internet culture from Portugal into the heart of our Paris office, creating content, leading creators, testing wild ideas, breaking things (in a good way), and helping us build Bump into a must-have app.

If that sounds like your dream job, keep reading.

You are:

  • Ambitious, driven, and wildly creative.

  • A natural storyteller who knows exactly why one video flops and another takes off.

  • Someone who spends more time on TikTok than you'd ever admit publicly.

  • Comfortable giving creators feedback that actually makes their content better.

  • Deeply tuned into Portuguese memes, humour, and online culture.

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English, and have lived in Portugal.

  • Excited to work onsite in Paris, with a fast-moving team.

  • Scrappy, energetic, experimental, you love trying 10 ideas to find the 1 that blows up, yet rigorous and detail oriented.

What You'll Do:

  • Grow Bump in Portugal (yep, you'll actually own this).

  • Lead all content + creator efforts for the Portuguese market.

  • Make high-performing TikToks, Reels, and UGC-style ads that people actually want to watch.

  • Build and manage a pipeline of Portuguese creators.

  • Run influencer campaigns with top Portuguese creators and micro-influencers.

  • Work closely with paid marketing to turn great content into great performance.

  • Jump on trends before they hit the For You Page.

jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 5 weeks of paid time off;

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

jobs.title: Head of Security - Fjord Base AS
jobs.description:
Fjord Base Gruppen er et konsern med ca. 100 ansatte bestående av 3 selskaper innenfor utvikling og drift av forsyningsbasen Fjord Base i Florø. Som Norges største forsyningsbase, med hele 65 selskap etablert på området, er vi et viktig knutepunkt mellom sjø og land. Vi tilbyr effektive havneoperasjoner og totale logistikkløsninger for offshore industrien. Vi er stolt av vår historie fra etableringen i 1985, som pålitelig leverandør til internasjonale selskaper og som en hjørnesteinsbedrift i Florø-samfunnet.

Fremover skal vi videreutvikle eksisterende aktivitet, og har klare vekstambisjoner. Vi skal styrke Fjord Base som logistikknutepunkt for offshore industrien, samtidig som vi skal legge til rette for nye grønne næringer. Vi har status som «Grønn Hub» for vår kapasitet til å lykkes med det grønne skiftet. Vi satser innenfor flere nye grønne industrier, med mål om å tilrettelegge for bærekraftig virksomhet og sirkulære verdikjeder.Vår visjon: Vi kobler mennesker og teknologi for å bygge fremtidens logistikkløsninger.

Vi ser nå en Head of Security / Leder Sikring til å bli med oss på laget!

Head of Security / Leder Sikring

Sikring er et stadig viktigere fagområde for Fjord Base Gruppen, og en sentral del av fundamentet for sikker og robust drift. Som et stort logistikknutepunkt med mange aktører, kunder og samarbeidspartnere stilles det høye krav til hvordan vi arbeider med sikring og risikostyring. Samtidig er fagområdet i stadig utvikling, og økte krav gjør at vi ønsker å styrke dette arbeidet ytterligere. Vi søker derfor en leder for sikring til en nøkkelrolle i den videre utviklingen av sikringsarbeidet hos oss. Vil du være med å drive dette arbeidet fremover? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg!

Dine ansvarsområder:

Som leder for sikring får du et overordnet ansvar for å drive og videreutvikle sikringsarbeidet i Fjord Base Gruppen. Rollen er både strategisk og operativ, og innebærer både eget fagansvar, samt koordinering på tvers av fagområder, eksterne samarbeidspartnere og kunder. Du vil ha gode faglige støttespillere rundt deg, samtidig som du har en nøkkelrolle i å sikre helhet, fremdrift og systematikk i arbeidet. Sentrale oppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Ansvarlig for ISPS-sikring ved Fjord Base og ivaretakelse av rollen som PFSO (Port Facility Security Officer)

  • Overordnet ansvar for konsernets øvrige sikringsarbeid, herunder ON091, og koordinering mot relevante fagområder som cybersikkerhet, personellsikring og beredskap

  • Drive utvikling og forbedring av konsernets sikringsarbeid

  • Følge opp overordnede risikovurderinger, sikringsrisikoanalyse, krav og tiltak, og bidra til at disse omsettes til gode løsninger i konsernet

  • Sikre at styrende dokumentasjon og planer er oppdatert og relevant

  • Være en sentral kontaktperson innen sikring overfor kunder, myndigheter og samarbeidspartnere

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant kompetanse innen sikring, og som har stor interesse og innsikt i fagområdene. Du har høy grad av integritet og etisk bevissthet. Vi ser for oss at du eksempelvis har erfaring fra politi, forsvaret, eller fra andre virksomheter med tydelige krav til sikring, beredskap og risikostyring. Vi tror du har:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning og erfaring innen sikring, sikkerhet og beredskap

  • God forståelse for risiko, forebyggende sikringsarbeid og regelverksforståelse

  • Gjerne erfaring fra komplekse virksomheter eller miljøer med høye krav til sikkerhet og sikring

  • Erfaring med ISPS og rolle som PFSO vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav

For å lykkes og trives i rollen så ser vi for oss at du er initiativrik, har høy grad av struktur, og er trygg i møte med ulike mennesker og fagmiljøer. Du evner å se helheten, samtidig som du sørger for fremdrift og følger opp det som er viktig. Du bygger gode relasjoner, kommuniserer tydelig, og har høy integritet og god rolleforståelse. Vi ser ikke etter noen som kan alt fra første dag. Vi ser etter deg som har et solid faglig fundament, er lærevillig, og som motiveres av å holde deg oppdatert og drive sikringsarbeidet videre i et fagområde i kontinuerlig utvikling.

Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Vi kan tilby en nøkkelrolle med stor påvirkning på vårt arbeid med sikring fremover, og å kunne bidra til gode og helhetlige løsninger sammen med et solid fagmiljø. Du blir en del av et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger i et konsern med høyt fokus på utvikling av våre ansatte. Vi tilbyr også gode velferdsordninger, blant annet treningsrom, Florø’s beste kantine, og hytte på Stranda – for å nevne noe! Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.Stillingen har arbeidssted i våre lokaler i Florø. Det vil bli gjennomført bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater som en del av ansettelsesprosessen. Er du nysgjerrig på om dette kan være stillingen for deg? Ta gjerne kontakt med en av våre rådgivere hos Visere AS:Asbjørn Grini – 917 94 825 / Asbjorn@visere.noDaniel Klakegg Dvergsdal – 904 79 470 / Daniel@visere.no Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad og CV innen 29. november 2026.

jobs.title: Facility Manager
jobs.description:
Om rollen 🚀

Vi søker nå en Facility Manager til en tidsbegrenset stilling hos en av våre internasjonale kunder i Norge. Du vil være basert på kontoret til et globalt selskap innen teknologi og profesjonelle tjenester, i et dynamisk og internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø.

Som Facility Manager vil du ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-leveransen på lokasjonen og sørge for at arbeidsplassen fungerer effektivt, sikkert og med høy kvalitet.

Du vil være kundens primære kontaktperson innen Facility Management og samarbeide tett med leverandører, servicepartnere og resten av Four FM-organisasjonen. Lede, støtte og følge opp Facility Coordinator på samme lokasjon og sørge for tydelige prioriteringer, godt samarbeid og høy kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen.

Rollen kombinerer operativt ansvar med koordinering av medarbeidere, kundeoppfølging, oppfølging av tjenester og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid.

Du vil blant annet: ✨

• Ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-driften på lokasjonen.

• Lede, støtte og koordinere Facility Coordinator på lokasjonen.

• Være kundens primære kontaktperson og bygge gode relasjoner med relevante interessenter.

• Koordinere og følge opp leverandører og eksterne servicepartnere.

• Sikre at tjenester leveres i henhold til avtalte kvalitetsstandarder, KPI-er og SLA-er.

• Følge opp kostnader og bidra til god budsjettoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

• Sikre etterlevelse av relevante HMS-rutiner, sikkerhetskrav og lokale bestemmelser.

• Håndtere daglige operative utfordringer på en proaktiv og løsningsorientert måte.

• Sikre at avtalte prosesser, rutiner og arbeidsmetoder følges.

• Identifisere og drive kontinuerlige forbedringer for å styrke kvalitet, effektivitet og den totale arbeidsplassopplevelsen.

Kort sagt: Du sørger for at arbeidsplassen fungerer godt, at teamet på lokasjonen får støtten og retningen de trenger, og at kunden mottar profesjonelle Facility Management-tjenester av høy kvalitet.

Dette er deg! 🎯

Du er en strukturert, serviceinnstilt og løsningsorientert person som trives med å ta ansvar og sørge for at ting fungerer.

Du er komfortabel med å jobbe i et kundenært miljø og kan veksle mellom planlegging, koordinering, oppfølging og håndtering av daglige operative utfordringer. Du liker å støtte andre og kan gi tydelig retning, samtidig som du samarbeider tett med kolleger, leverandører og andre interessenter.

Du kommuniserer godt med mennesker på ulike nivåer og har et naturlig fokus på kvalitet, service og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Vi tror at du har:

  • Erfaring innen Facility Management, workplace services, eiendomsdrift eller en lignende serviceorientert virksomhet.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere, støtte eller lede medarbeidere i et operativt miljø.

  • Erfaring med å jobbe tett med kunder og håndtere ulike interessenter.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere og følge opp leverandører og servicepartnere.

  • God forståelse for HMS og trygge arbeidsmetoder.

  • Forståelse for budsjett, kostnadsoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

  • En strukturert, proaktiv og selvstendig arbeidsform.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og trygghet i bruk av ulike systemer og verktøy.

  • Gode kommunikasjons- og relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter.

  • Flytende norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Kunnskap om teknisk Facility Management og grunnleggende forståelse for tekniske bygningssystemer er en fordel.

Hvorfor du vil trives hos oss ✨

Hos Four FM blir du en del av et selskap hvor du får tillit og reelt ansvar. Vi verdsetter initiativ, kvalitet og samarbeid, og gir medarbeiderne våre mulighet til å forme sine roller og bidra til hvordan vi utvikler tjenestene våre.

Verdiene våre C.A.R.E. – Compassion, Attention, Respect & Excellence – veileder oss i alt vi gjør. Vi bryr oss om mennesker, har fokus på detaljene og er stolte av å levere tjenester av høy kvalitet til kundene våre.

Praktisk informasjon 👩‍🏫

Arbeidstid:

Heltid, hovedsakelig innenfor ordinær kontortid, med noe fleksibilitet basert på driftsmessige behov.

Ansettelsesform:

Tidsbegrenset ansettelse fra 31. januar til 30. juni 2027.

Arbeidssted:

Hos kunden på Lysaker.

Oppstart:

Så snart som mulig / etter avtale.

Søknad:

Siste søknadsfrist: 14.12.2026

Vi gjennomfører utvelgelse og intervjuer fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å sende inn søknaden din så snart som mulig.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM er et nordisk facility management-selskap som leverer skreddersydde tjenester til bedrifter og eiendomsbesittere.

Vi samarbeider med selskaper som bryr seg om merkevaren sin, menneskene sine og miljøene de opererer i. Som partner – ikke bare leverandør – leverer vi fleksible løsninger med en sterk serviceinnstilling, veiledet av vår filosofi: We Take C.A.R.E.

jobs.title: Digital marketing professional – ready to build a brand of your own?
jobs.description: **I'm looking for a new entrepreneur and owner for Anna aikaa.**What if, instead of giving more things, we gave more time, well-being and meaningful experiences?This is the idea behind Anna aikaa (Finnish for "Give Time") – a digital gift card marketplace whose first service category is modern, dry-steam home cleaning.Through the platform, customers can give their loved ones the gift of an easier everyday life, while local cleaning entrepreneurs deliver the services.But why stop at cleaning?Anna aikaa has the potential to become a nationwide marketplace for experience and service-based gifts. The business does not require physical premises, inventory or its own service delivery staff. It can be operated remotely from anywhere.Who is this opportunity for?Someone who understands digital marketing, social media and consumer behaviour. jobs.title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund på Kimitoön
jobs.description: **Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund på Kimitoön. Besöken sker en gång i veckan.Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Vad gör en vård helppare?**En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:- hjälp vid dusch - uppföljning av hur senioren mår - stöd för att klara sig hemma - stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.Som vård helppare får du:- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap. - **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka. - **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning. - **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön! Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.Om du har frågor om att bli vårdar-helppare, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

Would you like to join us as a driver in Råde on weekends?

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.

What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic

What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

- Pri poskytovaní starostlivosti volí najmenšiu potrebnú mieru pomoci; činnosť, ktorú prijímateľ nezvládne ani s primeranou podporou, vykoná v potrebnom rozsahu a prijímateľa pritom zapája podľa jeho možností, rešpektuje jeho tempo, voľbu, súkromie a dôstojnosť.
- Sleduje telesný, psychický a emočný stav prijímateľa a zmeny významné pre poskytovanie starostlivosti; závažné alebo neobvyklé zistenia bezodkladne oznamuje príslušnému odbornému zamestnancovi alebo nadriadenému a zaznamenáva ich podľa interných postupov.

- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežnom živote v komunite a podľa jeho individuálnych potrieb ho sprevádza pri nákupoch, návšteve úradov, pošty, banky, zdravotníckych zariadení, školy, práce, kultúrnych, športových, voľnočasových a iných bežných aktivitách.Výhody:- osobné príplatky

jobs.title: Projektipäällikkö, korjausrakentaminen
jobs.description: Oletko kokenut korjausrakentamisen asiantuntija ja mietit uusia uramahdollisuuksia? Etsimme nyt Ouluun vakituiseen työsuhteeseen projektipäällikköä vaativiin korjausrakentamisen hankkeisiin. Mitä tehtävä sisältää? Projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa omien vahvuuksiesi ja osaamisesi mukaisessa roolissa. Taustastasi riippuen tehtäväsi painottuvat esimerkiksi rakennusteknisiin tutkimuksiin, rakennesuunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Sinun ei siis tarvitse olla kaikkien osa-alueiden asiantuntija, vaan tehtävänkuvaa rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta. Toimit asiakkaidemme asiantuntijana ja vastaat oman roolisi mukaisesti hankkeiden koordinoinnista ja ohjauksesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä yli toimialarajojemme, asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että hankkeet etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulun, kustannusten ja määräysten mukaisesti. Kulttuurimme kulmakiviä on tutkitusti ystävällinen työyhteisö ja matala hierarkia. Toimit osana monialaista korjausrakentamisen tiimiä, josta saat työkavereiksesi eri alojen asiantuntijoita. Vahva paikallinen yhteishenki ja tekeminen yhdistettynä valtakunnalliseen yhteistyöhön eri toimistojemme välillä tuo toimintaamme ketteryyttä, jota nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissakin tarvitaan. Päätökset teemme siellä, missä se on nopeinta ja kulloinkin järkevintä – tiimit on asetettu meillä päätöksenteon keskiöön. Talon sisäinen yhteistyö ja osaamisen jakaminen mahdollistavat sinulle pääsyn myös muiden alueiden hankkeisiin. Oulun toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella keskustan kupeessa, jossa meillä on modernit toimisto- ja neuvottelutilat sekä viihtyisät taukotilat. Työsi on liikkuvaa ja kohteet sijaitsevat Pohjois-Suomessa, pääosin Oulun seudulla. Avaimia tehtävässä menestymiseen Odotamme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vaativista korjausrakentamisen hankkeista sekä näyttöjä onnistuneesta asiakastyöstä. Sinulla on kokemusta pitkäjänteisestä yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden kanssa ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä tunnistaa asiakkaiden tulevia tarpeita. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, kuten rakennustekniikan insinöörin (AMK/YAMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Kokemuksesi painottuu kiinteistöihin ja voi painottua esimerkiksi tutkimukseen, suunnitteluun, projektinjohtoon, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Tärkeintä on vahva osaaminen omalla alueellasi sekä kokemus vastuullisesta roolista korjaushankkeissa. Arvostamme kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia ja viedä hankkeita tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa. Arvostamme myös RTA-, RAP-, RAV- tai KHK-pätevyyksiä. Meille on tärkeää asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työskentelytapa. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja vastuullinen ammattilainen, joka kuuntelee muita ja tuo samalla rohkeasti esiin omat näkemyksensä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää osaamistasi ja jakaa sitä myös muiden kanssa. Nous accompagnons principalement des investisseurs privés et des structures patrimoniales dans la constitution, la gestion, l'optimisation et la valorisation de leur patrimoine immobilier au Luxembourg. Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. Cela implique une attention particulier/ière à la préservation de leur valeur, à l'optimisation de leur rendement, à la maîtrise des coûts et à la qualité de leur entretien sur le long terme. Notre approche repose sur un accompagnement personnalisé, une grande disponibilité, une discrétion absolue et une relation de confiance avec nos clients. Nous ne nous limitons pas à la gestion quotidien/ienne des propriétés : nous cherchons également à anticiper les besoins, identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et conseiller nos clients dans leurs décisions patrimoniales. Nos activités s'articulent autour de trois pôles complémentaires :-   La gestion immobilier/ière et l'optimisation de portefeuilles : gestion administrative, technique et locative de biens immobiliers appartenant à différents propriétaires, avec une attention particulier/ière portée à leur rentabilité, leur entretien et leur valorisation. -   La promotion immobilier/ière : identification d'opportunités d'investissement, développement et réalisation de projets immobiliers, notamment résidentiels. -   La construction et la rénovation : à travers notre société AMAK Construction S.à r.l., nous réalisons et coordonnons des projets de construction, de transformation et de rénovation immobilier/ière.Cette complémentarité nous permet d'intervenir à toutes les étapes du cycle de vie d'un bien immobilier, de son acquisition à sa gestion, son développement et son éventuelle revente. Au sein de notre structure à taille humaine, les responsabilités peuvent évoluer en fonction des compétences, des intérêts et de l'engagement de chacun. jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.title: Čašníci a someliéri
jobs.description:
V Strachan Resorte v Ždiari nespájame len tradičnú goralskú pohostinnosť s prémiovou kvalitou, ale vytvárame pre našich hostí zážitky. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Hľadáme do nášho tímu profesionála, pre ktorého nie je gastronómia len prácou, ale srdcovou záležitosťou.

Náplň práce:

Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Aktívny predaj našich špecialít, prémiových vín a destilátov (radi ťa do všetkého zasvätíme).

Prestieranie stolov, udržiavanie čistoty a poriadku na rajóne.

Práca s pokladničným systémom a hotovosťou/terminálom.

Komunikácia s kuchyňou s cieľom zabezpečiť plynulý servis.

Reprezentovanie dobrého mena Strachan Resortu úsmevom a proaktívnym prístupom.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.
